recipe.visualDefinition: A tri-level vertical composition featuring a central square illustration of a personified sun rising over clouds, topped by bold block typography, and anchored by four high-contrast, solarized-style portraits of band members against a dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: The sun's rays create a radial movement that draws the eye upward to the primary text.
High-contrast, two-tone portraits provide a grounded, human element to the surreal illustration above.
The blue border acts as a unifying frame for the disparate illustrative and photographic elements.
coreInvariants: Personified sun with a calm, human face
Radial sunburst pattern in the upper half of the central square
Four-person portrait lineup with heavy black shadows and pink/yellow highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central square contains the primary illustration; the band portraits occupy the bottom third of that square; text is centered at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The personified sun in the center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the sun, moves up to the title text, then drops down to the band portraits at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A wide, solid blue border surrounds the central square and text elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows in portraits and cloud outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm pinks, oranges, and yellows within the sunburst and portrait highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portraits; mid-tone saturation in the illustration to maintain a vintage feel.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a 1960s palette: dusty blue, salmon pink, ochre, and black.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard heavy grotesque or impact-style forms.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two colors (pink and orange) to distinguish primary and secondary titles.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, sans-serif aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary verticality and tight spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vintage 1960s album cover layout. A central square contains a surreal illustration of a sun with a human face rising over stylized clouds with a radial sunburst background in pink and tan. Below the sun, place four high-contrast, two-tone (black and pink) portraits of people in a row. Surround the entire square with a wide, solid dusty-blue border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, uppercase, extra-bold condensed sans-serif text in the top blue border. The top line should be pink and the second line should be orange.

verificationChecks: Is the sun personified with a face?
Are the portraits high-contrast and two-tone?
Is the text condensed and heavy sans-serif?
Is the blue border consistent around the central square?

adjustableVariables: Number of portraits at the bottom
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the band members to avoid likeness issues
Any specific logos or brand marks

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn quality in the sun illustration

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sun face is visible and centered.
Verify the text is uppercase and condensed.
Confirm the tri-level vertical hierarchy is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a surreal central illustration with high-contrast human portraits and bold, condensed typography framed by a solid color border.
